content.markdown:
**V1.6.9** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on December 9th, 2022.

## V1.6.9

- Feature - [#15692](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15692) Increased number of small equipment slots
- Feature - [#15213](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15213) Weapons addon Arid base locations
- Feature - [#14388](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14388) Particle effects graphics option

- Fix - [#14677](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14677) [#14784](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14784) [#14751](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14751) Added editor arrows to steam train drive pistons to help place them correctly
- Fix - [#13910](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/13910) Character editor skin tone issue
- Fix - [#13948](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/13948) Fix controller move axes not working for noclip mode
- Fix - [#14313](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14313) Camera Set Origin Broken In Selection Grid
- Fix - Dogs picking up non-equipment items
- Fix - [#12627](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/12627) Moved overlapping train edit grid
- Fix - [#14607](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14607) Prevent crash when changing to an invalid resolution from fullscreen
- Fix - [#14730](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14730) Submarine island workbench physics mesh
- Fix - [#14762](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14762) Add delay between dropping equipment / using equipment boxes to prevent equipment duplication
- Fix - [#14843](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14843) Creatures not spawning blood effects when hit by rotors
- Fix - [#14847](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14847) Arid train terminal road geometry
- Fix - [#14852](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14852) Floating bridge geometry
- Fix - [#14876](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14876) Light on bridge not moving
- Fix - [#14880](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14880) Clipping through stairs on bridges
- Fix - [#14894](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14894) FJ warner boat dock physics mesh issues
- Fix - [#14907](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14907) Mineral funnel sound stuck after running out of material
- Fix - [#14909](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/14909) Fixed physics mesh for ladder in Olli switch yard
- Fix - [#15249](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15249) Addon lua docs formatting
- Fix - [#15014](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15014) Fix characters falling through floor after being released by a dragging animal
- Fix - [#15017](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15017) Invisible train barrier at Serpentine Trainyard
- Fix - [#15096](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15096) Thin physics at Beginner Base Fence
- Fix - [#15208](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15208) Brainz Train Yard Doorway Collision
- Fix - [#15272](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15272) North harbour lighting issues
- Fix - [#15308](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15308) Fix crash when despawning creature being carried / carrying equipment via LUA
- Fix - [#15313](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15313) Fixed overlapping terrain at kobold quarry
- Fix - [#15372](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15372) Prevent rope connections from disconnecting when entering 3rd person mode in seats
- Fix - [#15407](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15407) JSI dock teleport location
- Fix - [#15462](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15462) Fixed some trainline terrain issues
- Fix - [#15470](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15470) Not transparent windows
- Fix - [#15500](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15500) [#15501](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15501) Brainz terminal lights
- Fix - [#15581](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/15581) Road geometry issue

- Addon Lua:

Please take note that functions which interact with character inventories will need updating in accordance with new slots. SLOT_NUMBER |

1 = Large Equipment Slot,

2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 = Small Equipment Slot,

10 = Outfit Slot

## Source

- [Steam Community News](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/573090/view/3603472806456688511?l=english)
